race.description: Big Dance Eligibility Snake Gully Cup Hcp
race.comment: Handy mare TICKLEBELLY (1) was second-up from an eight-week let-up when a close second in the $250k Barn Dance over 1300m at Randwick on Melbourne Cup Day. Broke the course record in winning the 2025 renewal of this race under 57kgs off a less impressive lead-up run. Going well enough to chalk up back-to-back wins in the feature. BON HOLLER (10) showed pace but tired late when resuming over 1300m at Randwick last time out. Usually peaks third-up but she gets a few key gear changes today and this is an obvious target. ALABAMA STATE (2) saluted two runs back over today's distance at Rosehill then found the $500k Little Dance too rich last time. In the right race to bounce back to form. I'VE BEAN TRYIN' (5) scored twice in open company before being outclassed in the Big Dance over 1600m most recently. At his best over 1400m so a return to form looks on the cards. SUPER NORWEST (4) is another who can improve under more suitable circumstances this afternoon.
